name: 2026 Essentials
description: From the Steam Workshop collection 3642838301 (checked on Steam 2026-10-29: all 12 items public; collection updated 2026-01-21). A small vanilla-plus set: RTS Camera and RTS Command, Diplomacy, Improved Garrisons, Better Time, Kingdom Annexation, My Little Warband, Detailed Character Creation. The official modules are added when you create the playset, and Auto-sort puts Harmony, ButterLib, UIExtenderEx and Mod Configuration Menu first. Most of these mods were made for 1.3/1.4: check each mod's page for your game version. Not tested in a game.
